target.title: feat: let plugin tools yield turns
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Plugin tools can send work to an external interaction surface, but before this change they could only return a normal tool result. The agent loop could then continue in the same turn before the external callback arrived, which is a poor fit for native approval or form-card flows.

## Why This Is Better Than The Current Behavior

This adds a narrow runtime control request on `AgentToolResult` and exposes `yieldToolResult(...)` from `openclaw/plugin-sdk/tool-results`. When a plugin tool returns that result, OpenClaw records the tool result and routes through the existing `sessions_yield` runner path, ending the turn cleanly until a later inbound event resumes the session.

The implementation stays generic and channel-agnostic: channel plugins can opt in after their external side effect succeeds, while existing tools and plugins continue to behave the same when no `control` field is returned.

## User Impact

Plugin authors can implement native interaction tools, such as approval or form-card prompts, without racing the model loop against the eventual user callback. Existing plugin tools do not need configuration or migration.

## Verification

- `node scripts/docs-list.js` (direct script; `pnpm docs:list` attempted dependency hydration and was blocked by registry 451 for `baileys-7.0.0-rc13`)
- `node --max-old-space-size=8192 --experimental-strip-types scripts/generate-plugin-sdk-api-baseline.ts --check`
- `node node_modules/vitest/vitest.mjs run --config test/vitest/vitest.plugin-sdk.config.ts src/plugin-sdk/tool-results.test.ts --reporter=verbose --maxWorkers=1`
- `node node_modules/vitest/vitest.mjs run --config test/vitest/vitest.agents.config.ts src/agents/agent-tool-definition-adapter.test.ts --reporter=verbose --maxWorkers=1`

Note: `scripts/run-vitest.mjs ...` was also attempted for the focused tests, but the wrapper exited with code 137 and no output in this local environment. The same tests passed when run directly with the matching Vitest project configs above.
